name: provide_information_on_events
description: Provides information about the services available at the Ayuntamiento de Morón de la Frontera but does not directly answer questions about specific events.

name: provide_contact_information
description: Provides detailed information on how to contact Social Services and schedule appointments with the Ayuntamiento, including service hours and available contact methods.

outputs.description: Information on how to get in touch with Social Services, including options for in-person visits, phone calls, and online appointments with relevant links.

name: provide_general_assistance_context
description: Introduces the chatbot as part of the municipal citizen service team and prompts the user to indicate their needs for assistance.

name: provide_government_information
description: Shares information about the municipal government, including details on political parties and representation in the local governing body.

outputs.description: Information about the political parties, representation in the local government, and governing bodies.
Includes options to access more information about the municipal corporation.
URL to details of the municipal corporation.

name: provide_tax_payment_deadlines
description: Provides information on the deadlines for paying municipal taxes.

outputs.description: Dates for the payment of municipal taxes and tax payment periods based on type.

name: provide_job_opportunities_info
description: The chatbot informs the user about job opportunities and how to access job postings and application details.

outputs.description: General information about job offers, including where to find them and application requirements.

name: access_electronic_office
description: Prompts the user to access the Sede Electrónica of the Ayuntamiento by providing a link.

outputs.description: URL link to the Sede Electrónica for scheduling appointments and the Sede Electrónica of the Ayuntamiento.

name: provide_civil_registry_contact_info
description: Provides the user with the location and contact information for the Civil Registry or Registro Civil office.

outputs.description: Address and contact numbers for the Civil Registry.

name: provide_civil_marriage_initiation_info
description: Provides instructions and necessary contacts for initiating a civil marriage, including steps for registration and arrangements for the ceremony.

outputs.description: Steps for filing marriage at the Civil Registry and contacting the municipal office for ceremony arrangements, including phone details.

name: direct_user_to_contact
description: Informs the user that specific information is unavailable and directs them to an alternate contact method for further assistance.

outputs.description: WhatsApp contact number provided for further queries on youth programs.

name: suggest_resources_for_tax_payment_help
description: Suggests resources and services for individuals facing financial difficulties regarding tax payments, including providing information and contact details for relevant governmental organizations and social services.

outputs.description: Information on available services such as contacting the Servicio Andaluz de Empleo (SAE) and guidance related to Social Services assistance.
